integrity: Exact Newton-incidence decomposition, rational witness computations, and finite checker; no independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to four-element subsets with squared intrinsic Johnson graph distance, n>=8 and 0<q<=1. Positive semidefiniteness is proved analytically; independent validation and exhaustive originality search are not claimed.
title: A universal squared-distance Gaussian cutoff on four-subset Johnson slices
